MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 49

3. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)

   B. 26
   C. 170
   D. 13

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)

   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 5

5. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)

   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 21
   C. 3
   D. 15

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 1
   D. 73

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

13. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 1

15. Solve for x: x + 8 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 8

16. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
